'''Tatsuya Hasome''' (Japanese: '''羽染達也''' ''Hasome Tatsuya'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Hasome was born on May 15, 1989, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult, but only got very few roles in anime series, and was affiliated with the talent agency tristone. Hasome provided his voice for {{OBP|Pokémon Ranger|Ranger series}} {{ra|Ben}} during {{aniseries|DP}} of {{aniseries|PTS}}.
